notes: Milestones were selected by querying the Semantic Scholar public API for each maturation phase with phase-appropriate keyword strings. From each query's top-20 results, we kept the most-cited paper per query as a representative, then deduplicated across queries by title. The procedure is documented here so a reviewer can reproduce the selection or modify the queries and re-run.
